question: Estimate the number of police personnel in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Civil + armed police across states + central forces (CRPF, BSF, CISF, ITBP)? All.
Sanctioned or actual strength? Actual on rolls.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: State police (civil + armed) actual strength: ~22 lakh (sanctioned ~26 lakh; ~16% vacancies).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Police-to-population ratio: ~22 per 1 lakh population (UN recommended is 222 per 1 lakh — India is highly under-policed).
